The group info screen had the options I needed, but I had to tap around before finding them. The app is familiar, but this part still felt heavier than it should.

Day 2: Today the basic messaging worked, but the surrounding controls got in my way. The interaction was about voice note, not the message content itself. I wanted to adjust notifications for only one chat, but the setting felt buried. I knew the option probably existed, but finding it took too many taps. I left the app feeling like I had managed it rather than enjoyed it.

It worked in the end, just not as smoothly as I expected.

Day 6: Today the basic messaging worked, but the surrounding controls got in my way. I used the storage management area after getting several messages close together.
